speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms. To better understand your condition, can you describe the appearance and specific location of the rash?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: That history of working with livestock and rice farming is concerning. Have you noticed any blisters, specifically on your fingers or toes, or any changes in your urine color?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease).

The combination of pruritic rash, symmetric numbness/tingling in the palms, hypopigmented macules, and loss of eyebrow and eyelashes is highly characteristic of this condition. Given your history of livestock farming and rice paddy work, exposure to *Mycobacterium leprae* is likely.
